codes.label: Fixed
codes.definition: The applicable coupon is represented as fixed rather than linked to a reference rate for the stated period.

codes.label: Floating
codes.definition: The applicable coupon is represented as linked to a reference rate for the stated period.

codes.label: Hybrid or changing
codes.definition: The source establishes fixed and floating periods, a toggle, or another changing rate structure that cannot be represented as only fixed or only floating.

codes.label: Other established type
codes.definition: The source establishes a rate type outside the enumerated values; retain its exact description separately.

codes.label: USD SOFR
codes.definition: The source identifies a USD SOFR-based reference rate. Method and tenor remain separate required context.

codes.label: U.S. prime rate
codes.definition: The source specifically identifies a U.S. prime rate. This code is not interchangeable with an agreement-defined Base Rate or ABR.

codes.label: Agreement-defined Base Rate or ABR
codes.definition: The source identifies a Base Rate or ABR whose operative definition depends on the applicable agreement. It is not assumed to equal prime.

codes.label: USD federal funds rate
codes.definition: The source identifies a federal-funds-based reference rate; the exact convention remains required context.

codes.label: USD LIBOR
codes.definition: The source identifies USD LIBOR. Tenor, observation date and any fallback treatment remain separate context.

codes.label: EUR Euribor
codes.definition: The source identifies Euribor. Currency, tenor and convention remain separate context.

codes.label: GBP SONIA
codes.definition: The source identifies SONIA. Method and observation convention remain separate context.

codes.label: Other established reference rate
codes.definition: The source establishes another reference rate; retain its exact name and convention separately.

codes.label: Overnight
codes.definition: Overnight tenor as established by the source.

codes.label: One month
codes.definition: One-month tenor as established by the source.

codes.label: Three months
codes.definition: Three-month tenor as established by the source.

codes.label: Six months
codes.definition: Six-month tenor as established by the source.

codes.label: Twelve months
codes.definition: Twelve-month tenor as established by the source.

codes.label: Other established tenor
codes.definition: Another tenor established by the source; retain the exact source description separately.

codes.label: Term
codes.definition: A forward-looking term method as identified by the source.

codes.label: Daily simple
codes.definition: A daily-simple method as identified by the source.

codes.label: Compounded in arrears
codes.definition: A compounded-in-arrears method as identified by the source.

codes.label: Other established method
codes.definition: Another method established by the source; retain the exact convention separately.

codes.label: Current yield
codes.definition: Current yield as explicitly identified by the source.

codes.label: Yield to maturity
codes.definition: Yield to maturity as explicitly identified by the source.

codes.label: Yield to worst
codes.definition: Yield to worst as explicitly identified by the source.

codes.label: Discount margin
codes.definition: Discount margin as explicitly identified by the source; it is not the contractual spread_bps field.

codes.label: Effective yield
codes.definition: Effective yield as explicitly identified by the source.

codes.label: Internal rate of return
codes.definition: Internal rate of return as explicitly identified by the source.

codes.label: Other established yield measure
codes.definition: Another yield measure established by the source; retain its exact definition separately.
